measured_problem: The existing four compact heads across two width-192 paths produce only 0.975518 cosine and 0.212088 RMSE when followed by the exact source MLP. Even their ideal rank-384 static output span captures only 0.975245 attention-delta energy and misses final RMSE at 0.084057. The exact 32-head source block on the same replacement prefix passes, so a source-aligned sparse head representation is justified instead of further compact-head synthesis.
proposed_representation: Decompose exact source layer-one attention output into its 32 individual head contributions by observing the source o_proj input and applying each head's corresponding o_proj columns. Accumulate only a 32x32 contribution Gram matrix on train records. Deterministically forward-select the head that most reduces exact attention-delta reconstruction SSE, breaking ties by source-head index, and stop at the first subset reaching 0.98 reconstruction. Evaluate only that one train-derived subset on held-out records through the exact source MLP diagnostic.
portability_if_feasible: A later LayerCake implementation would copy only selected head Q/K/V row slices, the matching output-projection columns, and required normalization values into a LayerCake-native sparse-head operator. It would not retain a complete source block, unselected heads, the teacher object, or source-model inference dependencies.
decision: Authorize exactly one separately preregistered minimum source-head-subset oracle. A held-out pass authorizes an installable sparse-source-head LayerCake attention implementation and physical runtime screen. A miss closes exact unweighted head-subset transfer without head-count, ordering, weighting, source, data, prefix, MLP, or gate variants.
claim_boundary: Architecture review only; no selected subset, copied weights, model, autonomous quality, physical runtime, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
